A Feat new motion bitse bad be
Greatest Story Ever Told",
, is now being
produced by George Stevens Produc-
tions, Inc. and United Artists. The sets
for this film are among the largest ever
erected in California. They entail a rep-
lica of the central section of old Jerusa-
lem, and there are many other huge
sound stages representing familiar Bib-
lical locales.
Among the featured players are John
Wayne, Sidney Poitier, Charlton Heston
and Max Von Sydow. Carl Sandburg
collaborated on the script, and George
Stevens, twice an Academy Award Win-
ner, is Producer/Director.
From September 4 through April 30,
1963, these tours will leave at 9:00 AM,
10:30 AM, 2:00 PM and 3:30 PM from
9336 West Washington Boulevard, Cul-
ver City,
California. They include
visit to
the sound stages,
a bus trip
through the lot where the actual filming
will take place, and a special showing of
a film covering the extensive research
on the picture. A souvenir brochure is
available for each visitor.
American Airlines passengers-twelve
years of age and older-travelling in or
out of Los Angeles may pick up their
free tickets—at least 24 hours in advance
—at the American Airlines "Will Call"
desk at Los Angeles International Air-
port, or at all American Airlines ticket
offices.
Information regarding public transpor-
tation will be supplied with your ticket.
We hope you enjoy your trip and your film set tour
... another AMERICAN AIRLINES Special Service!

DEAR PASSENGER:
American Airlines has often been described as the leader in air transportation.
I hope we merit that distinction and will continue to merit it. To do that we
must continue to please you, the customer. Never entirely satisfied with our
service, each day we endeavor to make it better.
If you have suggestions to improve the service, please give us the benefit of
them. If your journey has been pleasant, tell us about it; it will encourage us.
If any individual rendered outstanding service, give me the name and we will
commend him or her for you. We are glad to have you aboard; I hope that
you will travel often with American.
Sincerely,
